answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens only a few new identity slots — a garden of verified traders, not an open field. Entrants bid; winners burn a fee and lock a deposit for 20 epochs, earning an umber seal. An attacker wanting 100 puppets must win 100 auctions: at 40 POA burned plus 200 POA locked per slot, that is 4,000 POA destroyed and 20,000 POA frozen. One honest agent pays once and earns it back in fees. The auction is an oasis among bots.
